sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Tahquamenon Falls State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483348: /api/maps + /api/resourcelocation/resources, map 'Lower Falls - Portage')

values.note: DNR rate table, Lower Falls-Portage: $41 with 20/30-amp, $46 with 50-amp. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Tahquamenon Falls / Lower Falls-Portage: Modern 50 AMP $46, Modern 20/30 AMP $41; season May 15 - October 14) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Recreation Passport required for vehicle entry), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Lower Falls Modern Campground: 'All sites have 30-amp service, and some 50-amp sites are available') + midnrreservations.com map 'Lower Falls - Portage' (82 campsites, all 'Electric Only', 16 with 50 Amps, Sewer Hookup 'No' on all), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 82 campsites on the booking site's 'Portage' loop map (the DNR counts 188 for the whole Lower Falls Modern Campground, Hemlock and Portage together); 8 pull-throughs; pad lengths 35-110 ft, most 45-65 ft.

sites.source: midnrreservations.com map 'Lower Falls - Portage' (82 campsites, Pull Through Yes 8, Site Length) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls ('Number of sites: 188', 'Pull-through sites available'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Lower Falls Modern Campground: 'Modern campground', 'Toilet & shower building', 'A sanitation station is available seasonally'; 'sanitation stations located at Lower Falls Modern Campground ... open seasonally mid-May to mid-October. Each has potable water') + DNR rates page ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station, water spigots'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Lower Falls Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: In winter the Portage loop is open for hike-in camping only.

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls ('In winter, the campground loop is open for hike-in camping'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed fees $41 (20/30-amp) to $46 (50-amp) with the Recreation Passport in fees.note; season May 15 - Oct 14 (manual) unchanged, plus a season note that winter camping is hike-in only. Added 50-amp (16 of 82 sites; all have 30-amp), no water/sewer at sites, 82 campsites with 8 pull-throughs (pads 35-110 ft), modern facilities with a seasonal sanitation station, reservable on midnrreservations.com. --AWH note kept: DNR agrees 'A few sites have river views', a quarter-mile from the Lower Falls. Not stated: max rig length, booking window/max stay for this park (left inherited).
flags: Website: the entry's website is the bare reservation home page https://midnrreservations.com/; the park's own page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Lower Falls Modern Campground section).
Phone: the entry has none; the park office is 906-492-3415 (DNR park page).
